newsitem.title: MALTA: TURNOVER DOWN AT MALTA EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: TURNOVER DOWN AT MALTA EXCHANGE.

text.p: Turnover during the once-a-week session of the Malta Stock Exchange fell on Wednesday to 364,000 Maltese pounds ($899,000) from the previous week's 2.4 million pounds.

Turnover in the equities market fell to 170,526 pounds, with 168,472 shares changing hands in 81 deals. The big trades were Bank of Valletta, with 51,182 shares exchanged at an average 146.7 cents, down five mils.
Mid-Med Bank shares gained 2.1 cents, with 3,918 shares traded at 178.9 cents.

The average share price of Lombard Bank Malta LBMA.MR slipped 1.7 cents, with 5,500 shares trading at an average 160.1 cents, and Middle Sea Insurance gained a cent, with 3,049 shares at 124 cents each.
Simonds Farsons Cisk lost 1.8 cents, with 2,500 shares selling for 46.2 cents.
There was no change in Suncrest Hotels, with 102,323 shares traded at an average of 73 cents.
In corporate bonds, there were seven deals for a total value of 7,334 pounds in the 7.25 Mid-Med Bank unsecured 2005, the average price falling five mils to 100.5 cents.
In Government bonds, turnover reached 186,588 pounds with 42 deals made in 16 securities. The share index slipped by 1.49 to close at 1087.56.
